crew.overview: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one—until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.
crew.title: Killers of the Flower Moon

details.biography:
Toni Marlo is a professional makeup artist and licensed esthetician as well as the owner of MarloHaus Makeup and Hair.  She is experienced and certified in stage, print, film, special effects makeup, and light hair, as well as licensed in facials, waxing, and light peels.

​Toni has designing hundreds of brides makeup looks for their big day and has been head of department for over 15 films. During her career she has even traveled nationally and internationally as a celebrity hair and makeup artist.
details.name: Toni Marlo
